# Derivation of the neo-Hookean material tangent {#sec-appendix-neo-hookean-tangent}

```{=latex}
\chaptershorttitle{Neo-Hookean Tangent}
```

This appendix derives the stress variation used in @sec-c9-linearization.
Let $\bm H$ be the increment of the deformation gradient $\bF$, as in
@eq-c9-stress-variation.

## Inverse and determinant variations

The neo-Hookean stress in @eq-model-neo-hookean-stress contains
$\bF^{-T}$ and $\ln J$. To differentiate it, take $\delta\bF=\bm H$ and
vary the identity $\bF\bF^{-1}=\bI$:

$$
\bm H\bF^{-1}+\bF\delta(\bF^{-1})=\bm0.
$$

Multiplying on the left by $\bF^{-1}$ and then transposing gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
\delta(\bF^{-1})&=-\bF^{-1}\bm H\bF^{-1},\\
\delta(\bF^{-T})&=-\bF^{-T}\bm H^T\bF^{-T}.
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-c9-inverse-variation}

The derivative of the determinant can be expressed through the cofactor
tensor $J\bF^{-T}$:

$$
\delta J=(J\bF^{-T}):\bm H
=J\tr(\bF^{-1}\bm H).
$$ {#eq-c9-determinant-variation}

Here $\bF^{-T}:\bm H=\tr(\bF^{-1}\bm H)$ follows from the definition
of the double contraction. Applying the scalar chain rule to $\ln J$ yields

$$
\delta(\ln J)=\frac{\delta J}{J}
=\tr(\bF^{-1}\bm H).
$$ {#eq-c9-log-variation}

All these formulas refer to the same perturbation $\delta\bF=\bm H$ and
require an invertible $\bF$; the logarithm also requires $J>0$.

## The neo-Hookean material tangent

Rewrite @eq-model-neo-hookean-stress as

$$
\bP(\bF)=\mu\bF+(\lambda\ln J-\mu)\bF^{-T}.
$$

The product rule first gives

$$
\delta\bP(\bF;\bm H)
=\mu\bm H+\lambda\delta(\ln J)\bF^{-T}
+(\lambda\ln J-\mu)\delta(\bF^{-T}).
$$

Substitution of @eq-c9-inverse-variation and @eq-c9-log-variation gives

$$
\boxed{\begin{aligned}
\delta\bP(\bF;\bm H)
={}&\mu\bm H
+\lambda\tr(\bF^{-1}\bm H)\bF^{-T}\\
&+(\mu-\lambda\ln J)\bF^{-T}\bm H^T\bF^{-T}.
\end{aligned}}
$$

This gives the material tangent in @eq-c9-neo-hookean-tangent.
